user.title: Select services
user.description: Select an existing UniFi integration. Setup starts with a preview and makes no router changes.

data.work_probe_enabled: Measure Microsoft 365 connectivity from the house
data.wifi_history_enabled: Store all-client Wi-Fi history every 30 minutes (local)

sources.title: Select destinations
sources.description: Separate values with commas. SAP requires documented destination prefixes for your services.

routes.title: Bind existing routes
routes.description: Bind each service to a separate existing IP route. WAN, device scope and enabled state are preserved. Services: {services}

network.title: Internet connections
network.description: Select the gateway. WAN1 and WAN2 are observed independently. Missing values remain unknown; availability over a measurement window does not prove current connectivity.

data.gateway_observer_enabled: Observe IPv4/IPv6 on the gateway (restricted SSH access)
data.ipv6_actor_enabled: Inspect the managed IPv6 policy with a separate key
data.ipv6_actor_active: Activate HA as the sole IPv6 policy writer

gateway_observer.title: Gateway observations
gateway_observer.description:
First install the documented gateway observer and authorize only this public key with the forced read-only command:

`{public_key}`

Confirm the Ed25519 host key through an already trusted connection. This integration does not change router rules.

ipv6_actor.title: IPv6 policy access
ipv6_actor.description:
Install the restricted gateway actor and authorize this dedicated public key with the fixed `service-route-sync ipv6 v1` command. Initial setup only inspects; activation requires a separate options change after the old writer is stopped.

`{public_key}`

clients.title: Monitored clients
clients.description: Select UniFi clients. Existing device profiles retain their grouped network adapters. New offline clients must be online for their first selection.

client_probe.title: Client probe access
client_probe.description:
Install the documented client observer with its fixed read-only command and private target configuration. Authorize this dedicated public identity:

`{public_key}`

Verify the gateway host key through an already trusted connection. Setup then validates all selected profiles.

reconfigure.title: Migrate client profiles
reconfigure.description: One-time administrator migration of existing client profiles with stable IDs and MAC groups. The dedicated probe access must already be provisioned and is verified before saving.

lady.title: Select LadyOfGames
lady.description: Select this PC’s network interfaces. Gaming profiles remain separate. New setups start with observation and no notifications. If the PC is offline, enter its known MAC address in the separate field.

data.lady_manual_mac: MAC address of an offline PC interface

lady_sources.title: Verify read-only sources

error.invalid_sources: Check selections and public destination CIDRs.
error.duplicate_routes: Each service needs a separate route.
error.invalid_routes: A selected route is no longer available.
error.immutable_router: Create a separate integration for a different router.
error.invalid_gateway: The selected gateway is no longer available.
error.invalid_observer_configuration: Invalid host key or WAN interfaces.
error.observer_unavailable: Observer unavailable or response invalid/stale. Check helper, keys and clocks.
error.invalid_clients: Select at least one valid client without duplicate assignments.

abort.router_unavailable: The selected UniFi integration is unavailable.
abort.no_routes: Create suitable IP-based routes on your UniFi gateway first.

abort.no_gateways: The UniFi integration exposes no supported gateway with WAN telemetry.
abort.observer_address_unavailable: The selected gateway has no valid local IP address.
abort.observer_key_unavailable: Unable to safely prepare the dedicated observer key.
abort.invalid_client_import: Invalid profile migration or probe access could not be verified.
abort.client_profiles_imported: Profiles migrated; the integration will reload.
abort.invalid_lady_configuration: The existing Lady configuration is invalid.

route_services.title: Route services
route_services.description: Select route feeds, source filters and existing UniFi route bindings. Network observers, client monitoring and control gates remain unchanged.

route_tls.title: Verified UniFi TLS certificate
route_tls.description: Enter the gateway certificate SHA-256 fingerprint and a dedicated route API key. Leave the key blank to keep the saved key. A live pinned read validates both before saving. Certificate rotation fails closed.

data.unifi_route_api_key: Dedicated route API key (blank keeps existing)

frigate_actor.title: Frigate control
frigate_actor.description: Select a provisioned connection for status observations. Save a new connection in observation mode first; restarts require separate enablement.

gateway_management.title: Use trusted gateway LAN address
gateway_management.description: Reuse the already pinned gateway identity and verify a read-only observation before saving.

data.use_existing_management_host: Use existing client observer management address

lady_mode.title: LadyOfGames operating mode
lady_mode.description: Enable notifications only after a verified import and stopping the legacy monitor. Switch back to observation here if needed.
